critical_findings: serversupervisor.com DA 74 is CONFIRMED as PBN/casino domain - seller explicitly labels it 'SEO / PBN Domains' on NamePros
jerusalemonline.com has HypeStat Authority Score 29 (NOT 64), 4,564 referring domains, 2.78M total backlinks - the DA 64 Moz estimate appears inflated
globalgeopark.org is a legitimate UNESCO-affiliated domain with 3,623 ETV and 814 organic keywords - strongest traffic signal after fitocracy
ghostautonomy.com and scififoods.com show ZERO traffic/keywords - dead startup domains with no residual SEO value
fiskerinc.com still has branded search traffic (70 ETV) but will decay rapidly post-bankruptcy
The DropCatch/NamePros $59 BIN PBN lot (serversupervisor.com etc) are ALL ex-casino PBN domains - DA numbers are likely inflated from PBN link schemes
ektopos.com ranked keywords are bondsman/bail bonds spam - the site was likely hijacked or redirected, NOT a Greek real estate site

domains.notes: DA 47 is UNVERIFIED Moz estimate. StatShow shows rank #1,164,590 with 12.3K monthly visitors. DataForSEO shows only 7 keywords ALL in bail bonds/bondsman niche (positions 42-86) - this suggests the site was SPAM/REDIRECTED, NOT a legitimate Greek real estate site. 23-year domain age (2003) is valuable but current content/links are suspect. Rank decreased 28% in 3 months.
domains.bid_recommendation: $75-100 max (domain name value only, SEO equity suspect)

domains.notes: DA 51 UNVERIFIED. StatShow shows rank #329,120 and 43.5K monthly visitors which would be consistent with DA 30-40 range. However, DataForSEO shows only 20 organic keywords with near-zero ETV ($6.2) and NO top-10 positions. This is a 26-year-old domain (2000). The discrepancy between StatShow traffic and DataForSEO keyword data suggests historical authority that has significantly declined. Registered to Warren Ransom via GoDaddy but WHOIS shows expiry 2012 - domain may have lapsed and been re-registered.

HypeStat Authority Score 29 is SIGNIFICANTLY lower than Moz estimate DA 64. However, 4,564 referring domains and 2.78M backlinks is a MASSIVE backlink profile. The discrepancy suggests many links are low-quality or the domain has been penalized. Mentions from The Guardian, The Independent, The Atlantic confirm real editorial backlinks. 28-year domain (1998). DataForSEO shows ZERO US organic keywords/traffic which is alarming. HypeStat shows 5,193 keywords in top-20 globally. This is likely a domain with strong international (non-US) authority. CRITICAL: DA 64 is WRONG. Real authority is closer to 29-40 range.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 29-40 (HypeStat 29 verified, but massive backlink profile suggests higher)
domains.bid_recommendation: $200-300 (strong backlink profile + 28yr age, but authority lower than claimed)

domains.notes: STRONGEST traffic signal of all 15 domains. 814 organic keywords globally with $3,623 monthly ETV. 249 US keywords with 46 in top-10 positions. This is a LEGITIMATE UNESCO-affiliated domain (Global Network of National Geoparks). Currently returns HTTP 403 but keywords still ranking. DA 49 estimate is PLAUSIBLE given the traffic data - consistent with a DR 35-50 range. UNESCO affiliation means editorial backlinks from .gov and .edu sources. 19-year domain (2007). Expires 2027.
domains.bid_recommendation: $200-350 (legitimate UNESCO domain, strong organic rankings, .org TLD)

domains.notes: HUGE discrepancy. StatShow shows rank #45,194 and 316K monthly visitors (which would suggest DA 50+), but DataForSEO shows only 4 keywords with $3 ETV. The StatShow data may be outdated (possibly from the site's peak). The site is a Spanish-language beauty/wellness portal targeting Latinas in the USA (27 years old, since 1999). 8,840 Google indexed pages. If StatShow traffic is even partially current, DA 40-50 is plausible. But DataForSEO showing near-zero suggests massive decline. GoDaddy hosting (184.168.176.1). RISK: domain may have already expired/been dropped given the age.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 20-40 (StatShow peak vs DataForSEO current shows steep decline)
domains.bid_recommendation: $100-175 (strong domain name for Hispanic beauty niche, but authority declining)

domains.notes: ZERO organic traffic/keywords in DataForSEO. Shut down April 2024 (over 2 years ago). Despite $220M funding and OpenAI backing, the domain has ZERO residual SEO value detectable. The DR 45 estimate from funding correlation is ALMOST CERTAINLY WRONG - the fitocracy.com lesson (est DR 37, actual DA 3) applies here. With zero rankings, actual DR is likely sub-10. TechCrunch and other press articles link to the domain but authority has decayed completely. The domain was a startup that pivoted multiple times and never achieved mass consumer adoption.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 3-10 (zero traffic = near-zero authority despite press links)
domains.bid_recommendation: $50-75 max (brand value only, ZERO SEO equity, likely overvalued by funding correlation)

domains.notes: ZERO organic traffic/keywords. Company shut down in 2024 after failing to commercialize cultivated meat burger. Originally Artemys Foods (2019), rebranded to SCiFi Foods (2022). $40M raised. The website scififoods.com still appears to be live with a farewell message. Press links exist from food/tech publications but ZERO SEO value remains. DR 25 estimate from funding correlation is UNRELIABLE - apply fitocracy lesson. Never sold a single product to consumers.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 3-8 (zero traffic, dead startup, no consumer brand recognition)
domains.bid_recommendation: $30-50 max (cool brand name for sci-fi niche, but ZERO SEO equity)

domains.notes: STILL HAS ACTIVE ORGANIC TRAFFIC. 13 keywords ranking with 5 in top-10 (including #1 for 'fisker inc website'). This is branded navigational traffic that will decay over time but hasn't yet. StatShow shows rank #251,800 with 56.8K monthly visitors. Massive press coverage from tier-1 publications. Wikipedia article with extensive backlinks. The key question is whether the domain will be sold as part of bankruptcy proceedings or allowed to expire. DR 55 estimate from funding correlation is PLAUSIBLE here given the actual rankings and massive press backlink profile. This was a publicly traded company (unlike Ghost/SciFi). However, a post-bankruptcy domain will lose authority rapidly.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 35-55 (active rankings + massive press profile support mid-high range)
domains.bid_recommendation: $150-300 (IF it drops - likely sold in bankruptcy proceedings, may not be available)

domains.notes: VERIFIED Moz DA 3 (Sprint 7). The poster child for why funding-based DR estimates are unreliable (was estimated DR 37). Despite DA 3, still has 19 organic keywords with $289 ETV and ranks #1 for branded terms 'fitocracy', 'fitocracy app', 'fitocracy macros'. StatShow shows rank #869,142 with 16.5K monthly visitors. 99 Moz linking domains. The domain has branded navigational value but near-zero link authority. Only 3,350 Google indexed pages. Domain age 18 years (2007).
domains.bid_recommendation: $50-75 (brand name value only, DA 3 means minimal SEO equity)

domains.notes: DR 27 from Ahrefs was verified in a prior sprint and is the most reliable number we have. However, DataForSEO shows ZERO organic keywords/traffic. StatShow shows no global rank (too low traffic). Domain is parked for sale on Afternic. 275 referring domains with 851 backlinks. Notable ethereum.org backlink. Domain expires Oct 2026. The DR 27 + ethereum.org link makes this valuable for dev tools redirect despite zero current traffic.
domains.bid_recommendation: $200-350 (best verified DR in portfolio, ethereum.org link, dev tools niche)

domains.notes: CRITICAL FINDING: Seller on NamePros EXPLICITLY labels this listing as 'SEO / PBN Domains' and admits these domains were 'briefly used in the casino niche (1-2 years)'. The DA 74 is almost certainly INFLATED from PBN link schemes. DataForSEO shows ZERO organic keywords/traffic which DIRECTLY CONTRADICTS a genuine DA 74. A real DA 74 domain would have hundreds or thousands of organic keywords. The 'real editorial backlinks still live and indexed' claim may be true from before the PBN era, but the inflated DA from casino PBN links makes this domain toxic for legitimate SEO. Google may have penalized or will penalize the PBN link profile.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 5-15 REAL (DA 74 is PBN-inflated, domain has ZERO organic rankings)
domains.bid_recommendation: DO NOT BUY ($59 wasted - PBN/casino domain with inflated DA, Google penalty risk)

domains.notes: DR 20 claimed by seller on NamePros with 19K backlinks. Price dropped from $300 to $50 (red flag - why so aggressive?). DataForSEO shows ZERO organic keywords/traffic. 19K backlinks with DR 20 suggests most backlinks are low-quality or spammy. A legitimate DR 20 with 19K backlinks would typically show SOME organic rankings. The zero traffic combined with high backlink count is consistent with a spam/PBN profile. Registered with Spaceship. Expires Nov 2026.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 5-15 (zero traffic contradicts DR 20, likely spam backlinks)
domains.bid_recommendation: $25-35 max (risky - zero traffic + 19K backlinks = likely spam profile)

domains.notes: DR 21 claimed by seller with 192K backlinks and 942 linking websites. Moz PA 43 also claimed. 20-year DNS history is legitimate. However, DataForSEO shows ZERO organic keywords/traffic. 192K backlinks from only 942 referring domains means avg 204 links per domain - this is an extremely high ratio that suggests automated/scraper/spam backlinks. The PA 43 claim (vs presumably low DA) also suggests old PageRank that hasn't translated to modern authority. This is a download site domain (.org TLD) which is a high-spam-risk niche.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 10-20 (DR 21 plausible but 192K spam backlinks are concerning)
domains.bid_recommendation: $40-59 (marginal value at $59, 20yr age + .org TLD, but spam backlink risk)

domains.notes: DA 41 claimed but UNVERIFIED. DataForSEO shows ZERO organic keywords/traffic. This was a real restaurant in Lafayette, LA (Blue Dog Cafe, Executive Chef Ryan Trahan, at 1211 W Pinhook Rd). If the restaurant closed, the domain may retain local/niche backlinks from restaurant review sites, OpenTable, Yelp, etc. However, ZERO organic traffic means whatever authority existed has decayed. The DA 41 could be from historical local business backlinks but is unverifiable. Restaurant domains typically have moderate backlink profiles from local directories, food blogs, and review sites.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 15-30 (restaurant domain, likely local backlinks, but zero current traffic)
domains.bid_recommendation: $50-80 (local restaurant brand, moderate backlink potential, unverified DA)

domains.notes: DA 55 claimed but COMPLETELY UNVERIFIED. DataForSEO shows ZERO organic keywords/traffic. No web search results found for this domain at all - no cached profiles, no mentions, no analysis. This is a generic news domain name with no verifiable authority. A real DA 55 domain would have significant organic rankings. The complete absence of any web presence data combined with zero DataForSEO metrics strongly suggests the DA 55 claim is FALSE. This domain has characteristics consistent with inflated/manipulated DA metrics.
domains.verified_da_estimate: 3-10 (ZERO evidence of any authority, DA 55 claim is almost certainly false)
domains.bid_recommendation: DO NOT BUY (no verifiable authority, likely fraudulent DA claim)
